# Thirza Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Eighty-five years old (Volume 5)  <sub>[v1 c25 P61](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0061), [v3 c22 P3](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0003), [v5 c2 P6](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0006)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c2 P6](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0006), [v5 c3 P6](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c6 P36](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0036), [v4 c4 P8](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0008)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Abernethy  <sub>[v1 c6 P5](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0005), [v1 c6 P12](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0012), [v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011)</sub>; Aunt Thirza  <sub>[v5 c3 P6](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Thirza is a tall, slender woman with sharp angles rather than curves. In her middle age, she had dark hair with graying strands bound tightly at the back in a firm bun pierced combatively with wire hairpins. By eighty-five, her hair has turned snow-white. Although she suffered from failing sight around her sixties, her vision in later years unexpectedly improved beyond what it used to be.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v2 c26 P14](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0014), [v3 c7 P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016), [v5 c2 P6](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0006)_

## Personality

Thirza is rigid, reserved, and unyielding in her moral sense, holding high expectations for neatness and decorum. She strongly dislikes emotional displays or translucent expressions of affection, considering intense feelings improper to exhibit publicly. Despite her stern, austere demeanor and sharp tongue, she harbors deep capacity for affection and hidden softness. Over time, particularly through her relationship with Nell, her sharp temperament mellows into a gentler maturity.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c38 P46](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0046), [v3 c7 P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016)_

- Maintain proper order, morality, and decorum at Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c7 P29](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0029), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003)</sub>
- Provide proper upbringing and education to orphan children in her care  <sub>[v1 c7 P29](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0029), [v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007)</sub>

## History

Thirza Abernethy lived a quiet, structured life at Grey Shutters in Brierley alongside her brother Obed. Expecting to adopt an orphan boy from Nova Scotia to work the farm, an error resulted in Obed bringing home Nell Harcourt instead. Although initially surprised and skeptical, Thirza permitted Nell to stay and raised her with strict discipline and growing affection. Following Obed's death, Thirza contemplated selling Grey Shutters due to financial and sight difficulties, but Nell chose to stay in Brierley to preserve the home. Later, Thirza agreed to take in twin orphans, Robin and Lucy Farrow, raising them to adulthood. Following the passing of her neighbor Thomas Sowerby, Thirza invited Mrs. Agatha Sowerby to live with her at Grey Shutters. In her old age, Thirza remains living at Grey Shutters, warmly receiving visits from Nell's children.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c3 P4](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0004), [v1 c6 P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v1 c12 P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046), [v1 c37 P10](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0010), [v1 c38 P12](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0012), [v1 c38 P23](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0023), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c26 P4](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0004), [v2 c26 P28](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0028), [v5 c2 P6](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0006), [v5 c3 P6](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0006)_

## Quotes

> We communicated, Obed and I, requesting that you deliver a boy from the asylum to us. We instructed your brother Robert to inform you that our desire was a boy aged ten or eleven.  <sub>[v1 c6 P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003)</sub>

> No; you can just address me as Thirza. Being called Miss Abernethy is something I am unaccustomed to, and it would cause me to feel nervous.  <sub>[v1 c8 P9](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0009)</sub>

> No. I am not an aunt to you, and I disbelieve in using names for people that do not belong to them.  <sub>[v1 c8 P13](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0013)</sub>

> It came to his attention that Grey Shutters was to be sold by me, and he desires to purchase it.  <sub>[v1 c38 P12](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0012)</sub>

> Oh, will it NEVER end?  <sub>[v4 c19 P4](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0004)</sub>
